definitions.gloss: letter of resignation; written request to resign
definitions.explanation: A formal document in which an employee or official asks to be allowed to leave their post. Phrased as a request for permission, reflecting that the resignation must be accepted by a superior.

examples.japanese: {辞職願|じしょくねがい}を{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I submitted a letter of resignation.

examples.japanese: {部長|ぶちょう}に{辞職願|じしょくねがい}を{提出|ていしゅつ}した。
examples.english: I handed in my letter of resignation to the department head.

examples.japanese: {責任|せきにん}を{取|と}って、{彼|かれ}はその{日|ひ}のうちに{辞職願|じしょくねがい}を{書|か}いた。
examples.english: Taking responsibility, he wrote his letter of resignation that very day.

notes:
Formed from {辞職|じしょく} (resignation) plus {願|ねがい} (request). The {願|ねがい} ending frames it as asking permission to resign, used when the resignation is subject to approval.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {辞職願|じしょくねがい}を{出|だ}す: to submit a resignation letter
- {辞職願|じしょくねがい}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する: to hand in a resignation letter
- {辞職願|じしょくねがい}を{受理|じゅり}する: to accept a resignation letter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {退職願|たいしょくねがい}: letter of resignation — used for ordinary employees leaving a company
- {辞表|じひょう}: letter of resignation — more formal; typical for executives and officials
